   330	set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
   331	-- The pi- and tensor-instance towers exceed the default unification budget.
   332	/-- **Zariski gluing of the étale plus construction**: a family of plus classes on a
   333	finite covering family of localizations of `A`, compatible on the pairwise overlap
   334	localizations, is the family of restrictions of a plus class on `A`.  Together with
   335	`PicEtAff.eq_of_away_eq` this is the Zariski sheaf property of `PicEtAff C ·` on affine
   336	tests, the gluing engine of the Layer-2 functor. -/
   337	theorem exists_mapAlg_eq_of_compat (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
   338	    (x : ∀ i, PicEtAff C (S i))
   339	    (hcompat : ∀ i j, PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   340	        ((IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (g i) (g i * g j) (S i) (T i j)
   341	          (dvd_mul_right (g i) (g j))).restrictScalars k) (x i)
   342	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   343	        ((IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (g j) (g i * g j) (S j) (T i j)
   344	          (dvd_mul_left (g j) (g i))).restrictScalars k) (x j)) :
   345	    ∃ z : PicEtAff C A,
   346	      ∀ i, PicEtAff.mapAlg C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i)) z = x i := by
   347	  classical
   348	  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
   349	  -- representatives
   350	  have hrep : ∀ i, ∃ (E : Algebra.EtaleCover (S i)) (ξ : descentClasses C E),
   351	      x i = PicEtAff.mk C E ξ := by
   352	    intro i
   353	    induction x i using PicEtAff.ind with | _ E ξ => exact ⟨E, ξ, rfl⟩
   354	  choose E ξ hx using hrep
   355	  -- scalar towers for the covering carriers
   356	  haveI htower : ∀ i, IsScalarTower k A (E i).Carrier := fun i =>
   357	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
   358	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (S i) (E i).Carrier c,
   359	        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k A (S i) c,
   360	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (S i) (E i).Carrier (algebraMap k A c)]
   361	  -- the pair conditions
   362	  have hpair : ∀ i j,
   363	      relPicAlgMap C (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
   364	        (E i).Carrier →ₐ[k] (E i).Carrier ⊗[A] (E j).Carrier)
   365	        ((ξ i : relPic C (overSpec k (E i).Carrier)))
   366	      = relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
   367	          (E j).Carrier →ₐ[A] (E i).Carrier ⊗[A] (E j).Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   368	        ((ξ j : relPic C (overSpec k (E j).Carrier))) := by
   369	    intro i j
   370	    refine relPicAlgMap_tensor_eq_of_compat C
   371	      (IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (g i) (g i * g j) (S i) (T i j)
   372	        (dvd_mul_right (g i) (g j)))
   373	      (IsLocalization.Away.algHomOfDvd (g j) (g i * g j) (S j) (T i j)
   374	        (dvd_mul_left (g j) (g i)))
   375	      (E i) (E j) (g i) (g j) (ξ i) (ξ j) ?_
   376	    rw [← hx i, ← hx j]
   377	    exact hcompat i j
   378	  -- lift the underlying classes to the product
   379	  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := relPic.exists_pi_lift C (fun i => (E i).Carrier)
   380	    (fun i => (ξ i : relPic C (overSpec k (E i).Carrier)))
   381	  -- the product cover of the base
   382	  obtain ⟨W, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_etaleCover_pi g S hg E
   383	  set ζW : relPic C (overSpec k W.Carrier) :=
   384	    relPicAlgMap C (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k) ζ with hζW
   385	  -- the descent condition of the lifted class over `A`
   386	  have hmem : ζW ∈ descentClasses C W := by
   387	    rw [mem_descentClasses_iff]
   388	    -- transport to the pi-decomposition of the tensor square
   389	    set Ψ : (W.Carrier ⊗[A] W.Carrier)
   390	        ≃ₐ[A] Π p : ι × ι, (E p.1).Carrier ⊗[A] (E p.2).Carrier :=
   391	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr e e).trans
   392	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.piDoubleEquivA A (fun i => (E i).Carrier)) with hΨ
   393	    apply relPicAlgMap_algEquiv_injective C (Ψ.restrictScalars k)
   394	    rw [show (Ψ.restrictScalars k).toAlgHom = Ψ.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k from rfl,
   395	      ← relPicAlgMap_comp, ← relPicAlgMap_comp, hζW, ← relPicAlgMap_comp,
   396	      ← relPicAlgMap_comp]
   397	    -- componentwise over the finite product
   398	    refine relPic.eq_of_pi_proj_eq C
   399	      (fun p : ι × ι => (E p.1).Carrier ⊗[A] (E p.2).Carrier) (fun p => ?_)
   400	    rw [← relPicAlgMap_comp, ← relPicAlgMap_comp]
   401	    -- identify the two composites
   402	    have hcompL : (Pi.evalAlgHom k
   403	          (fun p : ι × ι => (E p.1).Carrier ⊗[A] (E p.2).Carrier) p).comp
   404	          (((Ψ.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k).comp
   405	            ((doubleInl W : W.Carrier →ₐ[k] W.Carrier ⊗[A] W.Carrier))).comp
   406	            (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k))
   407	        = (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
   408	            (E p.1).Carrier →ₐ[k] (E p.1).Carrier ⊗[A] (E p.2).Carrier).comp
   409	          (Pi.evalAlgHom k (fun i => (E i).Carrier) p.1) := by
   410	      ext z
   411	      simp [hΨ, doubleInl, Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply,
   412	        Algebra.TensorProduct.piDoubleEquivA, Algebra.TensorProduct.piPiAlgEquiv_tmul]
   413	    have hcompR : (Pi.evalAlgHom k
   414	          (fun p : ι × ι => (E p.1).Carrier ⊗[A] (E p.2).Carrier) p).comp
   415	          (((Ψ.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k).comp
   416	            ((doubleInr W : W.Carrier →ₐ[k] W.Carrier ⊗[A] W.Carrier))).comp
   417	            (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k))
   418	        = (AlgHom.restrictScalars k (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
   419	            (E p.2).Carrier →ₐ[A] (E p.1).Carrier ⊗[A] (E p.2).Carrier)).comp
   420	          (Pi.evalAlgHom k (fun i => (E i).Carrier) p.2) := by
   421	      ext z
   422	      simp [hΨ, doubleInr, Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply,
   423	        Algebra.TensorProduct.piDoubleEquivA, Algebra.TensorProduct.piPiAlgEquiv_tmul]
   424	    rw [hcompL, hcompR, relPicAlgMap_comp, relPicAlgMap_comp, hζ p.1, hζ p.2]
   425	    exact hpair p.1 p.2
   426	  -- the glued class and its restrictions
   427	  refine ⟨PicEtAff.mk C W ⟨ζW, hmem⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
   428	  rw [hx i]
   429	  refine mapAlg_mk_eq_mk C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i)) W (E i) ⟨ζW, hmem⟩ (ξ i)
   430	    ((Pi.evalAlgHom k (fun j => (E j).Carrier) i).comp
   431	      (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k)) (fun a => ?_) ?_
   432	  · change (Pi.evalAlgHom k (fun j => (E j).Carrier) i) (e (algebraMap A W.Carrier a))
   433	      = _
   434	    rw [e.commutes a]
   435	    change algebraMap A ((E i).Carrier) a = _
   436	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (S i) ((E i).Carrier) a]
   437	    rfl
   438	  · change relPicAlgMap C ((Pi.evalAlgHom k (fun j => (E j).Carrier) i).comp
   439	        (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k)) ζW
   440	      = (ξ i : relPic C (overSpec k (E i).Carrier))
   441	    rw [hζW, ← relPicAlgMap_comp,
   442	      show ((Pi.evalAlgHom k (fun j => (E j).Carrier) i).comp
   443	          (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k)).comp (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k)
   444	        = Pi.evalAlgHom k (fun j => (E j).Carrier) i from AlgHom.ext fun z => by
   445	          simp]
   446	    exact hζ i
   447	
   448	end Glue

     9	/-!
    10	# Zariski separation of the étale plus construction
    11	
    12	The affine étale Picard functor `PicEtAff C ·` is a separated presheaf for the Zariski
    13	topology of affine tests: two plus classes over `A` agreeing on every member of a finite
    14	basic-open cover of `Spec A` agree (`AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.eq_of_away_eq`).
    15	
    16	Route: the plus construction of *any* presheaf is separated — representatives agreeing
    17	on each localization agree on an étale cover assembled from the local witnessing covers,
    18	and the finite product of the witnessing carriers is again an étale cover of the base.
    19	The gluing across the factors of the product is the relative Picard decomposition of a
    20	finite product of test algebras (`AlgebraicGeometry.relPic.eq_of_pi_proj_eq`,
    21	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RelPicPi`).
    22	
    23	The file also provides `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.exists_relPicAlgMap_eq_of_mapAlg_eq`,
    24	the representative-level unfolding of an equality of restricted plus classes, consumed
    25	by the gluing half (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtAffZariskiGlue`).
    26	-/
    27	
    28	set_option autoImplicit false
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory
    33	
    34	open scoped TensorProduct
    35	
    36	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    37	
    38	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    39	
    40	namespace PicEtAff
    41	
    42	/-! ## Unfolding an equality of restricted plus classes -/
    43	
    44	/-- Unfolding an equality of restrictions of two plus classes along two algebra maps
    45	into a common test algebra `R`: the descent-class representatives admit refinement maps
    46	into a common étale cover of `R`, semilinear over the restriction maps, with equal
    47	transports of the underlying relative Picard classes. -/
    48	theorem exists_relPicAlgMap_eq_of_mapAlg_eq {A₁ A₂ R : Type u}
    49	    [CommRing A₁] [Algebra k A₁] [CommRing A₂] [Algebra k A₂] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    50	    (φ₁ : A₁ →ₐ[k] R) (φ₂ : A₂ →ₐ[k] R)
    51	    (E₁ : Algebra.EtaleCover A₁) (E₂ : Algebra.EtaleCover A₂)
    52	    (ξ₁ : descentClasses C E₁) (ξ₂ : descentClasses C E₂)
    53	    (h : mapAlg C φ₁ (mk C E₁ ξ₁) = mapAlg C φ₂ (mk C E₂ ξ₂)) :
    54	    ∃ (H : Algebra.EtaleCover R) (m₁ : E₁.Carrier →ₐ[k] H.Carrier)
    55	      (m₂ : E₂.Carrier →ₐ[k] H.Carrier),
    56	      (∀ a : A₁, m₁ (algebraMap A₁ E₁.Carrier a) = algebraMap R H.Carrier (φ₁ a))
    57	        ∧ (∀ a : A₂, m₂ (algebraMap A₂ E₂.Carrier a) = algebraMap R H.Carrier (φ₂ a))
    58	        ∧ relPicAlgMap C m₁ (ξ₁ : relPic C (overSpec k E₁.Carrier))
    59	            = relPicAlgMap C m₂ (ξ₂ : relPic C (overSpec k E₂.Carrier)) := by
    60	  letI : Algebra A₁ R := φ₁.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    61	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A₁ R := .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ₁.commutes a).symm
    62	  letI : Algebra A₂ R := φ₂.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    63	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A₂ R := .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ₂.commutes a).symm
    64	  have h' : PicEtAff.map C R (mk C E₁ ξ₁) = PicEtAff.map C R (mk C E₂ ξ₂) := h
    65	  rw [map_mk, map_mk] at h'
    66	  obtain ⟨H, r₁, r₂, hr⟩ := (mk_eq_mk_iff C).mp h'
    67	  refine ⟨H,
    68	    (r₁.restrictScalars k).comp ((E₁.baseChangeInclude R).restrictScalars k),
    69	    (r₂.restrictScalars k).comp ((E₂.baseChangeInclude R).restrictScalars k),
    70	    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    71	  · intro a
    72	    change r₁ (E₁.baseChangeInclude R (algebraMap A₁ E₁.Carrier a)) = _
    73	    rw [AlgHom.commutes (E₁.baseChangeInclude R) a,
    74	      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A₁ R ((E₁.baseChange R).Carrier) a,
    75	      AlgHom.commutes r₁ (algebraMap A₁ R a)]
    76	    rfl
    77	  · intro a
    78	    change r₂ (E₂.baseChangeInclude R (algebraMap A₂ E₂.Carrier a)) = _
    79	    rw [AlgHom.commutes (E₂.baseChangeInclude R) a,
    80	      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A₂ R ((E₂.baseChange R).Carrier) a,
    81	      AlgHom.commutes r₂ (algebraMap A₂ R a)]
    82	    rfl
    83	  · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hr
    84	    rw [descentMap_coe, descentMap_coe, descentBaseChange_coe, descentBaseChange_coe,
    85	      ← relPicAlgMap_comp, ← relPicAlgMap_comp] at hval
    86	    exact hval

    88	/-! ## Zariski separation -/
    89	
    90	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    91	variable {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (g : ι → A)
    92	variable (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)]
    93	  [∀ i, Algebra A (S i)] [∀ i, IsScalarTower k A (S i)]
    94	  [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
    95	
    96	/-- A finite covering family of localizations assembles the local étale covers into an
    97	étale cover of the base: the product of the carriers. -/
    98	theorem exists_etaleCover_pi (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    99	    (K : ∀ i, Algebra.EtaleCover (S i)) :
   100	    ∃ W : Algebra.EtaleCover A, Nonempty (W.Carrier ≃ₐ[A] Π i, (K i).Carrier) := by
   101	  classical
   102	  haveI : ∀ i, Algebra.Etale A (S i) := fun i =>
   103	    Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway (g i)
   104	  haveI : ∀ i, Algebra.Etale A (K i).Carrier := fun i =>
   105	    Algebra.Etale.comp A (S i) (K i).Carrier
   106	  haveI : Algebra.Etale A (Π i, (K i).Carrier) := inferInstance
   107	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective
   108	      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Π i, (K i).Carrier))) := by
   109	    intro p
   110	    -- some `g i` lies outside `p`
   111	    have hexists : ∃ i, g i ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   112	      by_contra hall
   113	      have hle : Ideal.span (Set.range g) ≤ p.asIdeal := by
   114	        rw [Ideal.span_le]
   115	        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
   116	        exact of_not_not fun hc => hall ⟨i, hc⟩
   117	      rw [hg] at hle
   118	      exact p.isPrime.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hle)
   119	    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hexists
   120	    -- lift through the localization and the local cover
   121	    have hploc : p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (S i))) := by
   122	      rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range (S := S i) (g i)]
   123	      exact hi
   124	    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hploc
   125	    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (K i).comap_surjective q
   126	    refine ⟨PrimeSpectrum.comap (Pi.evalRingHom (fun j => (K j).Carrier) i) r, ?_⟩
   127	    have hcomp : (Pi.evalRingHom (fun j => (K j).Carrier) i).comp
   128	        (algebraMap A (Π j, (K j).Carrier)) = algebraMap A ((K i).Carrier) := rfl
   129	    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp_apply, hcomp,
   130	      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A (S i) ((K i).Carrier),
   131	      PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp_apply, hr, hq]
   132	  exact ⟨Algebra.EtaleCover.of (Π i, (K i).Carrier) hsurj,
   133	    ⟨Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv (Π i, (K i).Carrier) hsurj⟩⟩
   134	
   135	/-- **Zariski separation of the étale plus construction**: two plus classes over `A`
   136	agreeing on every member of a finite covering family of localizations agree. -/
   137	theorem eq_of_away_eq (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) {x y : PicEtAff C A}
   138	    (h : ∀ i, PicEtAff.mapAlg C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i)) x
   139	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i)) y) :
   140	    x = y := by
   141	  classical
   142	  -- reduce to triviality of the ratio
   143	  suffices hone : ∀ z : PicEtAff C A,
   144	      (∀ i, PicEtAff.mapAlg C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i)) z = 1) → z = 1 by
   145	    have hxy := hone (x * y⁻¹) fun i => by
   146	      rw [map_mul, map_inv, h i, mul_inv_cancel]
   147	    exact mul_inv_eq_one.mp hxy
   148	  intro z hz
   149	  induction z using PicEtAff.ind with | _ G ζ =>
   150	  -- unfold each local triviality to a refinement witness
   151	  have hloc : ∀ i, ∃ (K : Algebra.EtaleCover (S i)) (m : G.Carrier →ₐ[k] K.Carrier),
   152	      (∀ a : A, m (algebraMap A G.Carrier a)
   153	        = algebraMap (S i) K.Carrier (algebraMap A (S i) a))
   154	      ∧ relPicAlgMap C m (ζ : relPic C (overSpec k G.Carrier)) = 1 := by
   155	    intro i
   156	    have hi : mapAlg C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i)) (mk C G ζ)
   157	        = mapAlg C (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i))
   158	            (mk C (.self A) (1 : descentClasses C (.self A))) := by
   159	      rw [hz i, PicEtAff.mk_one C (.self A), map_one]
   160	    obtain ⟨K, m₁, m₂, hm₁, hm₂, hval⟩ := exists_relPicAlgMap_eq_of_mapAlg_eq C
   161	      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i)) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A (S i))
   162	      G (.self A) ζ 1 hi
   163	    refine ⟨K, m₁, fun a => ?_, ?_⟩
   164	    · exact hm₁ a
   165	    · rw [hval, show ((1 : descentClasses C (.self A)) :
   166	        relPic C (overSpec k (Algebra.EtaleCover.self A).Carrier)) = 1 from rfl,
   167	        map_one]
   168	  choose K m hmcomm hmone using hloc
   169	  -- assemble the product cover
   170	  obtain ⟨W, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_etaleCover_pi g S hg K
   171	  -- the joint refinement map
   172	  have hmA : ∀ i, ∀ a : A, m i (algebraMap A G.Carrier a)
   173	      = algebraMap A ((K i).Carrier) a := by
   174	    intro i a
   175	    rw [hmcomm i a, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (S i) ((K i).Carrier) a]
   176	  -- the underlying relative Picard class dies on the product
   177	  have hpi : relPicAlgMap C
   178	      (Pi.algHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun j => m j))
   179	      (ζ : relPic C (overSpec k G.Carrier)) = 1 := by
   180	    refine relPic.eq_of_pi_proj_eq C (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun i => ?_)
   181	    rw [← relPicAlgMap_comp, map_one,
   182	      show (Pi.evalAlgHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) i).comp
   183	          (Pi.algHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun j => m j))
   184	        = m i from AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl]
   185	    exact hmone i
   186	  -- transport through the carrier identification
   187	  have hW : relPicAlgMap C
   188	      ((e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k).comp
   189	        (Pi.algHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun j => m j)))
   190	      (ζ : relPic C (overSpec k G.Carrier)) = 1 := by
   191	    rw [relPicAlgMap_comp, hpi, map_one]
   192	  -- the joint refinement map is an `A`-algebra map
   193	  have hcommA : ∀ a : A,
   194	      ((e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k).comp
   195	        (Pi.algHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun j => m j)))
   196	        (algebraMap A G.Carrier a) = algebraMap A W.Carrier a := by
   197	    intro a
   198	    have h1 : (Pi.algHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun j => m j))
   199	        (algebraMap A G.Carrier a) = algebraMap A (Π j, (K j).Carrier) a := by
   200	      ext j
   201	      exact hmA j a
   202	    change e.symm ((Pi.algHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun j => m j))
   203	      (algebraMap A G.Carrier a)) = _
   204	    rw [h1]
   205	    exact e.symm.commutes a
   206	  set nA : G.Carrier →ₐ[A] W.Carrier :=
   207	    { toRingHom := ((e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k).comp
   208	        (Pi.algHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun j => m j))).toRingHom
   209	      commutes' := hcommA } with hnA
   210	  have hval : descentMap C nA ζ = 1 := by
   211	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
   212	    rw [descentMap_coe,
   213	      show nA.restrictScalars k
   214	        = (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars k).comp
   215	            (Pi.algHom k (fun j => (K j).Carrier) (fun j => m j)) from
   216	        AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl]
   217	    exact hW
   218	  calc mk C G ζ = mk C W (descentMap C nA ζ) := (mk_descentMap C nA ζ).symm
   219	    _ = mk C W 1 := by rw [hval]
   220	    _ = 1 := mk_one C W
   221

    12	For a curve `C` over `k` and an affine test scheme `Spec A`, the étale-sheafified relative
    13	Picard group is computed by a *single* plus construction (the relative Picard presheaf is
    14	étale-separated, by descent — proved separately): a class of the plus is represented by a
    15	relative Picard class on an étale cover `Spec B → Spec A` equipped with a *descent
    16	condition* — equal pullbacks along the two projections of the double cover
    17	`Spec (B ⊗[A] B)` — and two representatives are identified when they agree on a common
    18	refinement.
    19	
    20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.descentClasses C E`: the subgroup of `relPic C (Spec B)` of classes
    21	  satisfying the descent condition on the cover `E` with carrier `B`.
    22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.descentMap C h`: transport of descent classes along a refinement map
    23	  `h` of covers.
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relPicAlgMap_congr` (**the keystone**): a descent class restricts
    25	  equally along any two `A`-algebra maps out of the cover carrier — the pair `(j₁, j₂)`
    26	  factors through the double cover, where the descent condition kills the difference.
    27	  Specialized to refinement maps as `AlgebraicGeometry.descentMap_congr`, this is what
    28	  makes the colimit below independent of all choices; applied across base rings
    29	  (`Picard/PicEtAffMap.lean`), it is also what makes the plus functorial in the test
    30	  algebra.
    31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff C A`: the one-step plus — descent classes on some cover,
    32	  modulo agreement on a common refinement — with its `CommGroup` structure and the
    33	  constructor/eliminator API `PicEtAff.mk`, `PicEtAff.ind`, `PicEtAff.mk_eq_mk_iff`,
    34	  `PicEtAff.mk_descentMap`.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.unit`: the unit `relPic C (Spec A) →* PicEtAff C A` of the
    36	  plus construction — a class pulled back to the trivial cover with its tautological
    37	  descent datum.
    38	
    39	The functoriality of `PicEtAff` in `A` (restriction along test maps, via base change of
    40	covers) and the comparison theorems (injectivity of the unit = separatedness; bijectivity
    41	under a section = rigidification) are subsequent layers, consuming only this interface.
    42	-/

    59	/-! ## Descent classes on an étale cover -/
    60	
    61	/-- The first coprojection from the carrier of a cover into its self-tensor product over
    62	the base — the algebra face of the first projection of the double cover
    63	`Spec (B ⊗[A] B) → Spec B` — as a `k`-algebra map. -/
    64	def doubleInl (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    65	    E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
    66	  Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
    67	
    68	/-- The second coprojection into the self-tensor product; see `doubleInl`. -/
    69	def doubleInr (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    70	    E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
    71	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight).restrictScalars k
    72	
    73	/-- The subgroup of relative Picard classes on an étale cover of the test algebra
    74	satisfying the descent condition: equal pullbacks along the two projections of the double
    75	cover. -/
    76	def descentClasses (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    77	    Subgroup (relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) :=
    78	  MonoidHom.eqLocus
    79	    (relPicAlgMap (B := E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) C (doubleInl E))
    80	    (relPicAlgMap (B := E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) C (doubleInr E))
    81	
    82	lemma mem_descentClasses_iff {E : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
    83	    {x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)} :
    84	    x ∈ descentClasses C E ↔
    85	      relPicAlgMap (B := E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) C (doubleInl E) x
    86	        = relPicAlgMap (B := E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) C (doubleInr E) x :=
    87	  Iff.rfl
    88	
    89	/-! ## Transport along refinement maps -/
    90	
    91	private lemma doubleInl_comp {E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A} (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) :
    92	    (doubleInl F).comp (h.restrictScalars k)
    93	      = ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map h h).restrictScalars k).comp (doubleInl E) := by
    94	  ext x
    95	  simp [doubleInl]
    96	
    97	private lemma doubleInr_comp {E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A} (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) :
    98	    (doubleInr F).comp (h.restrictScalars k)
    99	      = ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map h h).restrictScalars k).comp (doubleInr E) := by
   100	  ext x
   101	  simp [doubleInr]
   102	
   103	/-- The descent condition is natural in the cover: pullback along a refinement map sends
   104	descent classes to descent classes. -/
   105	lemma relPicAlgMap_mem_descentClasses {E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
   106	    (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) {x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)}
   107	    (hx : x ∈ descentClasses C E) :
   108	    relPicAlgMap C (h.restrictScalars k) x ∈ descentClasses C F := by
   109	  rw [mem_descentClasses_iff] at hx ⊢
   110	  calc relPicAlgMap C (doubleInl F) (relPicAlgMap C (h.restrictScalars k) x)
   111	      = relPicAlgMap C ((doubleInl F).comp (h.restrictScalars k)) x :=
   112	        (relPicAlgMap_comp C _ _ x).symm
   113	    _ = relPicAlgMap C (((Algebra.TensorProduct.map h h).restrictScalars k).comp
   114	          (doubleInl E)) x := by rw [doubleInl_comp h]
   115	    _ = relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map h h).restrictScalars k)
   116	          (relPicAlgMap C (doubleInl E) x) := relPicAlgMap_comp C _ _ x
   117	    _ = relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map h h).restrictScalars k)
   118	          (relPicAlgMap C (doubleInr E) x) := by rw [hx]
   119	    _ = relPicAlgMap C (((Algebra.TensorProduct.map h h).restrictScalars k).comp
   120	          (doubleInr E)) x := (relPicAlgMap_comp C _ _ x).symm
   121	    _ = relPicAlgMap C ((doubleInr F).comp (h.restrictScalars k)) x := by
   122	        rw [doubleInr_comp h]
   123	    _ = relPicAlgMap C (doubleInr F) (relPicAlgMap C (h.restrictScalars k) x) :=
   124	        relPicAlgMap_comp C _ _ x
   125	
   126	/-- Transport of descent classes along a refinement map of covers. -/
   127	def descentMap {E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A} (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) :
   128	    descentClasses C E →* descentClasses C F :=
   129	  ((relPicAlgMap C (h.restrictScalars k)).comp (descentClasses C E).subtype).codRestrict _
   130	    fun x => relPicAlgMap_mem_descentClasses C h x.2
   131	
   132	@[simp]
   133	lemma descentMap_coe {E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A} (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
   134	    (x : descentClasses C E) :
   135	    (descentMap C h x : relPic C (overSpec k F.Carrier))
   136	      = relPicAlgMap C (h.restrictScalars k) (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) :=
   137	  rfl
   138	
   139	@[simp]
   140	lemma descentMap_id {E : Algebra.EtaleCover A} (x : descentClasses C E) :
   141	    descentMap C (AlgHom.id A E.Carrier) x = x := by
   142	  ext
   143	  rw [descentMap_coe,
   144	    show (AlgHom.id A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k = AlgHom.id k E.Carrier from rfl]
   145	  exact relPicAlgMap_id C _
   146	
   147	lemma descentMap_comp {E F G : Algebra.EtaleCover A} (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
   148	    (h' : F.Carrier →ₐ[A] G.Carrier) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   149	    descentMap C (h'.comp h) x = descentMap C h' (descentMap C h x) := by
   150	  ext
   151	  rw [descentMap_coe, descentMap_coe, descentMap_coe,
   152	    show (h'.comp h).restrictScalars k
   153	      = (h'.restrictScalars k).comp (h.restrictScalars k) from rfl]
   154	  exact relPicAlgMap_comp C _ _ _
   155	
   156	/-- **Generalized refinement-map independence**, the keystone of the plus construction:
   157	a class satisfying the descent condition restricts equally along any two `A`-algebra maps
   158	out of the cover carrier — into an arbitrary test algebra, not merely another cover.  The
   159	pair `(j₁, j₂)` factors jointly through the double cover of the source, where the descent
   160	condition identifies the two pullbacks. -/
   161	theorem relPicAlgMap_congr {E : Algebra.EtaleCover A} {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
   162	    [Algebra k R] [Algebra A R] [IsScalarTower k A R] (j₁ j₂ : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] R)
   163	    {x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)} (hx : x ∈ descentClasses C E) :
   164	    relPicAlgMap C (j₁.restrictScalars k) x = relPicAlgMap C (j₂.restrictScalars k) x := by
   165	  set H : E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier →ₐ[A] R :=
   166	    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift j₁ j₂ fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _ with hH
   167	  have key₁ : (H.restrictScalars k).comp (doubleInl E) = j₁.restrictScalars k := by
   168	    ext y
   169	    simp [hH, doubleInl]
   170	  have key₂ : (H.restrictScalars k).comp (doubleInr E) = j₂.restrictScalars k := by
   171	    ext y
   172	    simp [hH, doubleInr]
   173	  calc relPicAlgMap C (j₁.restrictScalars k) x
   174	      = relPicAlgMap C ((H.restrictScalars k).comp (doubleInl E)) x := by rw [key₁]
   175	    _ = relPicAlgMap C (H.restrictScalars k) (relPicAlgMap C (doubleInl E) x) :=
   176	        relPicAlgMap_comp C _ _ _
   177	    _ = relPicAlgMap C (H.restrictScalars k) (relPicAlgMap C (doubleInr E) x) := by
   178	        have hx' : relPicAlgMap (B := E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) C (doubleInl E) x
   179	            = relPicAlgMap (B := E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) C (doubleInr E) x := hx
   180	        rw [hx']
   181	    _ = relPicAlgMap C ((H.restrictScalars k).comp (doubleInr E)) x :=
   182	        (relPicAlgMap_comp C _ _ _).symm
   183	    _ = relPicAlgMap C (j₂.restrictScalars k) x := by rw [key₂]
   184	
   185	/-- **Refinement-map independence**: any two refinement maps between the same covers
   186	transport descent classes identically — what makes the plus construction independent of
   187	all choices. -/
   188	theorem descentMap_congr {E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
   189	    (h₁ h₂ : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   190	    descentMap C h₁ x = descentMap C h₂ x :=
   191	  Subtype.ext (relPicAlgMap_congr C h₁ h₂ x.2)
   192	
   193	/-! ## The plus construction -/
   194	
   195	/-- Two descent-class representatives are identified when they agree after transport to a
   196	common refinement.  By `descentMap_congr` the choice of transport maps is immaterial, so
   197	the relation is an equivalence (directedness of covers gives transitivity). -/
   198	instance picEtAffSetoid : Setoid (Σ E : Algebra.EtaleCover A, descentClasses C E) where
   199	  r p q := ∃ (F : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (f : p.1.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
   200	    (g : q.1.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier), descentMap C f p.2 = descentMap C g q.2
   201	  iseqv := by
   202	    constructor
   203	    · exact fun p => ⟨p.1, AlgHom.id A _, AlgHom.id A _, rfl⟩
   204	    · rintro p q ⟨F, f, g, hfg⟩
   205	      exact ⟨F, g, f, hfg.symm⟩
   206	    · rintro p q r ⟨F, f, g, hfg⟩ ⟨G, f', g', hfg'⟩
   207	      refine ⟨F.prod G, (F.prodInl G).comp f, (F.prodInr G).comp g', ?_⟩
   208	      rw [descentMap_comp, descentMap_comp, hfg, ← descentMap_comp, ← descentMap_comp,
   209	        descentMap_congr C ((F.prodInl G).comp g) ((F.prodInr G).comp f') q.2,
   210	        descentMap_comp, hfg', ← descentMap_comp]
   211	
   212	variable (A) in
   213	/-- The one-step étale plus of the relative Picard functor at the affine test `Spec A`:
   214	relative Picard classes on some presented étale cover satisfying the descent condition,
   215	modulo agreement on a common refinement.  On affine tests this *is* the étale
   216	sheafification of the relative Picard presheaf (one plus suffices because the presheaf is
   217	étale-separated — proved separately). -/
   218	def PicEtAff : Type u :=
   219	  Quotient (picEtAffSetoid C (A := A))
   220	
   221	namespace PicEtAff
   222	
   223	/-- The plus class of a relative Picard class with a descent condition on a cover. -/
   224	def mk (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) : PicEtAff C A :=
   225	  Quotient.mk _ ⟨E, x⟩
   226	
   227	@[elab_as_elim]
   228	theorem ind {motive : PicEtAff C A → Prop}
   229	    (mk : ∀ (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E), motive (mk C E x)) :
   230	    ∀ q, motive q := by
   231	  intro q
   232	  induction q using Quotient.ind with
   233	  | _ p => exact mk p.1 p.2
   234	
   235	theorem mk_eq_mk_iff {E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A} {x : descentClasses C E}
   236	    {y : descentClasses C F} :
   237	    mk C E x = mk C F y ↔
   238	      ∃ (G : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] G.Carrier)
   239	        (g : F.Carrier →ₐ[A] G.Carrier), descentMap C f x = descentMap C g y :=
   240	  Quotient.eq
   241	
   242	/-- Transporting the representative to a finer cover does not change the plus class. -/
   243	@[simp]
   244	theorem mk_descentMap {E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A} (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
   245	    (x : descentClasses C E) : mk C F (descentMap C h x) = mk C E x :=
   246	  Quotient.sound ⟨F, AlgHom.id A F.Carrier, h, by rw [descentMap_id]⟩
   247	
   248	/-! ### The group structure -/
   249	
   250	/-- Transport through a `prodLift` collapses on the left factor. -/
   251	lemma descentMap_prodLift_inl {E F H : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
   252	    (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] H.Carrier) (g : F.Carrier →ₐ[A] H.Carrier)
   253	    (x : descentClasses C E) :
   254	    descentMap C (Algebra.EtaleCover.prodLift f g) (descentMap C (E.prodInl F) x)
   255	      = descentMap C f x := by
   256	  rw [← descentMap_comp, Algebra.EtaleCover.prodLift_comp_prodInl]
   257	
   258	/-- Transport through a `prodLift` collapses on the right factor. -/
   259	lemma descentMap_prodLift_inr {E F H : Algebra.EtaleCover A}
   260	    (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] H.Carrier) (g : F.Carrier →ₐ[A] H.Carrier)
   261	    (y : descentClasses C F) :
   262	    descentMap C (Algebra.EtaleCover.prodLift f g) (descentMap C (E.prodInr F) y)
   263	      = descentMap C g y := by
   264	  rw [← descentMap_comp, Algebra.EtaleCover.prodLift_comp_prodInr]
   265	
   266	set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
   267	-- The `rw` chain unifies `descentMap` nests whose `AlgHom` instance arguments run through
   268	-- quotient and tensor-product carriers; the unifications are heartbeat-hungry.
   269	private lemma mulLift_compat (p q p' q' : Σ E : Algebra.EtaleCover A, descentClasses C E)
   270	    (hp : p ≈ p') (hq : q ≈ q') :
   271	    mk C (p.1.prod q.1)
   272	        (descentMap C (p.1.prodInl q.1) p.2 * descentMap C (p.1.prodInr q.1) q.2)
   273	      = mk C (p'.1.prod q'.1)
   274	        (descentMap C (p'.1.prodInl q'.1) p'.2
   275	          * descentMap C (p'.1.prodInr q'.1) q'.2) := by
   276	  obtain ⟨F, f, f', hf⟩ := hp
   277	  obtain ⟨G, g, g', hg⟩ := hq
   278	  refine (mk_eq_mk_iff C).mpr ⟨F.prod G,
   279	    Algebra.EtaleCover.prodLift ((F.prodInl G).comp f) ((F.prodInr G).comp g),
   280	    Algebra.EtaleCover.prodLift ((F.prodInl G).comp f') ((F.prodInr G).comp g'), ?_⟩
   281	  rw [map_mul, map_mul, descentMap_prodLift_inl, descentMap_prodLift_inr,
   282	    descentMap_prodLift_inl, descentMap_prodLift_inr, descentMap_comp, descentMap_comp,
   283	    descentMap_comp, descentMap_comp, hf, hg]
   284	
   285	instance : Mul (PicEtAff C A) :=
   286	  ⟨fun a b => Quotient.liftOn₂ a b
   287	    (fun p q => mk C (p.1.prod q.1)
   288	      (descentMap C (p.1.prodInl q.1) p.2 * descentMap C (p.1.prodInr q.1) q.2))
   289	    fun p q p' q' hp hq => mulLift_compat C p q p' q' hp hq⟩
   290	
   291	lemma mk_mul_mk (E F : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E)
   292	    (y : descentClasses C F) :
   293	    mk C E x * mk C F y
   294	      = mk C (E.prod F)
   295	          (descentMap C (E.prodInl F) x * descentMap C (E.prodInr F) y) :=
   296	  rfl

   298	/-- Multiplication of two classes represented on the *same* cover is represented by the
   299	product on that cover — the descent condition makes the two transports to the common
   300	refinement agree. -/
   301	theorem mk_mul_mk_same (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x y : descentClasses C E) :
   302	    mk C E x * mk C E y = mk C E (x * y) := by
   303	  have h : descentMap C (E.prodInl E) x * descentMap C (E.prodInl E) y
   304	      = descentMap C (E.prodInl E) (x * y) :=
   305	    (map_mul _ x y).symm
   306	  rw [mk_mul_mk, descentMap_congr C (E.prodInr E) (E.prodInl E) y, h, mk_descentMap]

   314	/-- The identity class is represented by the identity on every cover. -/

   319	private def invSig (p : Σ E : Algebra.EtaleCover A, descentClasses C E) :

   337	instance : CommGroup (PicEtAff C A) where
   338	  mul_assoc a b c := by
   339	    induction a using ind with | _ E x =>
   340	    induction b using ind with | _ F y =>
   341	    induction c using ind with | _ G z =>
   342	    rw [← mk_descentMap C (((E.prod F).prodInl G).comp (E.prodInl F)) x,

   345	      mk_mul_mk_same, mk_mul_mk_same, mul_assoc]
   346	  one_mul a := by
   347	    induction a using ind with | _ E x =>
   348	    rw [one_def, mk_mul_mk, map_one, one_mul, mk_descentMap]
   349	  mul_one a := by
   350	    induction a using ind with | _ E x =>

   352	  inv_mul_cancel a := by
   353	    induction a using ind with | _ E x =>
   354	    rw [mk_inv, mk_mul_mk_same, inv_mul_cancel, mk_one]

   357	    induction b using ind with | _ F y =>
   358	    rw [← mk_descentMap C (E.prodInl F) x, ← mk_descentMap C (E.prodInr F) y,
   359	      mk_mul_mk_same, mk_mul_mk_same, mul_comm]

   361	/-! ### The unit of the plus construction -/
   362	
   363	/-- Every class pulled back from the base carries the tautological descent datum: the two
   364	composites `A → B ⇉ B ⊗[A] B` coincide. -/
   365	lemma tautological_mem_descentClasses (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   366	    (x : relPic C (overSpec k A)) :
   367	    relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) x
   368	      ∈ descentClasses C E := by
   369	  rw [mem_descentClasses_iff, ← relPicAlgMap_comp, ← relPicAlgMap_comp]
   370	  congr 2
   371	  ext a
   372	  simp [doubleInl, doubleInr, Algebra.ofId_apply]
   373	
   374	variable (A) in
   375	/-- The unit of the plus construction: a relative Picard class of the affine test,
   376	pulled back to the trivial cover with its tautological descent datum. -/
   377	def unit : relPic C (overSpec k A) →* PicEtAff C A where
   378	  toFun x := mk C (.self A)
   379	    ⟨_, tautological_mem_descentClasses C (.self A) x⟩
   380	  map_one' := by
   381	    rw [show (⟨_, tautological_mem_descentClasses C (.self A) 1⟩ :
   382	        descentClasses C (.self A)) = 1 from Subtype.ext (map_one _), mk_one]

     8	/-!

    10	
    11	The étale-plus Picard group `PicEtAff C A` is functorial in the affine test: a base
    12	extension `A → A'` restricts a plus class by base-changing its representing cover
    13	(`Algebra.EtaleCover.baseChange`) and transporting the descent datum along the canonical
    14	inclusion of the carrier into its base change.  Following the mathlib idiom for maps along
    15	base extensions, the extension is carried as instances `[Algebra A A'] [IsScalarTower k A A']`
    16	rather than as an explicit `k`-algebra map.

    19	  change of the cover — well-posed because the two coprojections of the base-changed double
    20	  cover restrict to `A`-algebra maps out of the original carrier, so the keystone
    21	  `relPicAlgMap_congr` applies.

    23	  `PicEtAff C A →* PicEtAff C A'`.
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_unit`: naturality of the unit of the plus construction.
    25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_id`, `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_map`: the functor
    26	  laws — both are instances of `relPicAlgMap_congr`, which erases the difference between
    27	  any two transports out of the same descent class.

    30	étale plus of the relative Picard functor on affine tests; the comparison theorems

   115	sigma-literal projection. -/

   119	    ∃ (G : Algebra.EtaleCover A')

   278	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ.commutes a).symm

   289	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A' :=
   290	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ.commutes a).symm

   292	  rw [mapAlg, map_unit, hφ]

   304	    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (ψ.commutes x).symm
